result.summary: Found 1 minor layout issue: inconsistent vertical alignment of cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. No critical or major visually broken elements were found.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are not top-aligned: the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card image sits noticeably lower than the 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol' cards beside it, so its title and delivery-fee text are also misaligned with the neighboring cards.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel items to the top and enforce a consistent fixed image aspect ratio/card height for every restaurant card in the row.
